author: no_bs_review
quote:
I can't remember the last time I wanted to get ****, being bored in a GTA when there's endless possibilities always is insane. Grew up with Vice City, San Andreas, IV, V and V Online to play a relationship simulator...
Jason is a boring character, has the personality of a brick. The start of the game Lucia is constantly spamming him whilst in prison, unskippable awkward convos and dance scenes, constantly allowing to hold hands and everything else inbetween.
Genuinely such a let down but is say 70% of us saw it coming.
